Your visit

Four steps, fitted around a working week.

1. Consultation

Tell us what you want from your smile and get an exact quote — no treatment, no pressure, on that first visit.

2. Design

Your veneer or makeover plan is mapped to your face and your schedule.

3. Treatment

Appointments run Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday, 8am–5pm, in the Suite 922 East rooms on Michigan Avenue.

4. The reveal

Walk out of a Magnificent Mile appointment and straight back into your day.

Since 1988

A dental spa, in the old sense of the word.

Mitchell Dental Spa has practised cosmetic dentistry on Chicago’s Magnificent Mile since 1988 — a luxury dental spa marketed to downtown professionals, built on porcelain veneers, smile makeovers and Invisalign rather than on rushed, high-volume dentistry. The practice’s own site was still publishing fresh guidance in September 2026, with a blog post on Lumineers versus porcelain veneers dated September 15, 2026.

Rated 4.9 out of 5 from 719 reviews on WebMD.

Questions, answered plainly

Before you book.

How much will my veneers cost exactly?

The published range is $1,200–$2,500 per tooth for porcelain veneers and $800–$2,000 per tooth for Lumineers. Your exact quote comes from a consultation.

When are you open?

Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday, 8am–5pm. Closed Wednesdays and weekends.

How do I book?

Use the form below — it opens your own email app addressed to the practice — or call (312) 642-1014.
